text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Woman, 23, jailed for three years for drug trafficking.
- Cost of living down slightly. The retail price index dropped by less than a point in July from June.
- Labour leader Alfred Sant meets Israel's Shimon Peres at Socialist International meeting in New York.
- First ever education fair opened. Government spending on education tops 390 million Maltese lira ($1 billion) in seven years.
- Armed Forces buy two Alouette helicopters from Dutch air force.
